title: OathBound
description: OathBoundMC Is A Public MC RPG Server With Many Bosses And Bedrock Support!
body:
⚔️ RPG SMP Economy! Dive into an epic world where adventure meets strategy — fight powerful custom bosses like the Ender Dragon, Wither, and Warden, each dropping rare ores used to craft legendary armor and weapons! 💎 Build your fortune in a player-driven economy, trade with others, and upgrade your gear to dominate the battlefield. 💰

Master unique skills and abilities, join thrilling server-wide events, and climb the ranks to earn monthly crates packed with exclusive rewards, cosmetics, and rare loot! 🎁 Team up with friends, conquer dungeons, and become the hero your realm needs in the ultimate RPG survival experience! 🌍🔥
